notes.title: Star Drifter version 1.12 is live. Patch fix.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have just updated the game build to version_1.12
Several bugs are gone and we improved the general performance.

When we went live we had some users reporting almost immediately about performance issues and some bugs here and there that we missed during our extensive testing phase.

The game is mostly solid, it's pretty much water tight, we were really rigorous during testing. But you always miss a few. It's the beauty of releasing to such a large audience like Steam. We always manage to root out a few sneaky bugs that evaded us during testing.

So thanks for trying Star Drifter and feeding back your experiences, whether that's on Steam, Facebook or via email, we truly appreciate it.
To anyone that has picked the game up on Steam, please drop us a review if you have the time. Honest reviews are massively appreciated and help us make this game and future games better.

You're awesome.

Dan and Martin.
